facts: The City of Hobart-managed route is 2km and links nine numerical sculptures. Each number relates to a historical weight, measure, time, quantity, date or distance. Location: Distance and trail description.

The trail starts from Salamanca Place and follows Battery Point and the river shore, with port and Derwent Estuary views. Location: Getting There and trail description. The requested City of Hobart URL redirects to its regional trails partner.
